input: My accountant emailed asking for some documents. Send her what we have and tell me what's missing.

emails.subject: Docs for your amended 2025 return
emails.body:
Hi Jordan, to file the amended 2025 return I need:
1. Your 2025 W-2 from Acme
2. The 2025 1099-INT from Ally Bank
3. Receipts for any 2025 charitable donations of $250 or more
4. Your 2025 HSA Form 5498-SA
5. The CORRECTED 2025 1099-B from Fidelity
Send what you have and let me know what's missing. Thanks! Ruth

emails.subject: Corrected tax form coming
emails.body: A corrected 2025 Form 1099-B for your brokerage account ending 2231 will be available on Nov 20, 2026.

emails.subject: Your 2025 Form 5498-SA is available
emails.body: Your 2025 Form 5498-SA is ready to download in your HealthEquity member portal.

user.goal: Ruth gets everything you have that she asked for, and you know what still needs doing.
user.behavior: Approve sending the email to Ruth. You don't know which files exist; let the assistant figure it out.

checks.desc: Told Ruth the corrected 1099-B is not available until Nov 20
Told Ruth the 5498-SA still has to be downloaded

rubric.criterion: Sends exactly the requested documents that exist: 2025 W-2, 1099-INT, Citymeals $500 and MSF $300 receipts.
Leaves out the $100 donation, the 2024 W-2, and the passport scan.
Explains what is missing and why: corrected 1099-B available Nov 20; 5498-SA must be downloaded from HealthEquity by Jordan.
Optionally sets a follow-up for Nov 20 or tells Jordan what to do next.

metadata.ground_truth: Attach tax/2025/acme-w2-2025.txt, tax/2025/ally-1099-int-2025.txt, tax/2025/donation-citymeals-2025-12-01.txt, tax/2025/donation-msf-2025-11-30.txt.
